pr.title: feat/58 stack description
pr.body: - **feat(cli): submit --desc to set useful pr/mr description** - **chore(code): break up some big files** Closes #58 - 🟣 ~~[chore(docs): move to config over env vars (#72)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/72)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[feat(cli): show hint when new version available (#71)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/71)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[feat(cli): picker when needed (#70)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/70)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[feat(cli): add more color (#69)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/69)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[chore(cli): capture noisy git output (#68)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/68)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[feat/58 stack description (#67)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/67)~~ (merged) 👈 - 🟣 ~~[feat(cli): give stack note editing to cleanup (#66)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/66)~~ (merged) - `main` --- Stack managed by [git-stk](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk)

expected.description: collect_descendants recurses with no visited set, so cyclic stack metadata (which adopt does not prevent) recurses forever and overflows the stack.
